description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing client collateral data within the Fineract system. It includes endpoints for retrieving, adding, updating, and deleting client collateral information, utilizing JAX-RS annotations, integrated with Spring's component model, and documented with Swagger annotations.

classes.name: ClientCollateralManagementApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class for managing client collateral operations including retrieval, addition, update, and deletion of collateral data.

methods.name: getClientCollateral
methods.description: Retrieves a list of collaterals for a specific client, optionally filtered by product ID.

methods.name: getClientCollateralData
methods.description: Fetches detailed collateral data for a specific collateral ID.

methods.name: getClientCollateralTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves collateral template data for a client, likely used for UI forms.

methods.name: addCollateral
methods.description: Adds new collateral information for a specific client.

methods.name: updateCollateral
methods.description: Updates existing collateral data for a client.

methods.name: deleteCollateral
methods.description: Deletes specified collateral data for a client.
